Bash(.specify/scripts/bash/create-new-feature.sh --json '# Feature: AI Chat Endpoint

## Goal
Provide a stateless HTTP API endpoint that accepts user messages and returns AI-generated responses for managing todos.

## Description
The backend exposes a single chat endpoint that:
- Receives a natural language message
- Loads conversation history from the database
- Runs an AI agent to decide actions
- Returns the assistant response
- Does not store any in-memory state

## Endpoint
POST /api/{user_id}/chat

## Request
- conversation_id \(optional\): integer
- message \(required\): string

## Behavior
- If conversation_id is missing, create a new conversation
- Persist user message before agent execution
- Build agent context using stored messages
- Execute AI agent
- Persist assistant response
- Return conversation_id and response text

## Constraints
- Server must remain stateless
- No business logic inside the endpoint
- All task operations must be delegated to tools
- Authentication is required

## Acceptance Criteria
- Endpoint returns valid AI responses
- Conversations survive server restarts
- Multiple concurrent chats work correctly
- Unauthorized requests are rejected' --number 1 --short-name "ai-chat-endpoint")

Bash(.specify/scripts/bash/create-new-feature.sh --json --number 2 --short-name "chat-api-endpoint" --description "Add a stateless chat API endpoint that enables conversational todo management.

The system must:
- Expose POST /api/{user_id}/chat
- Accept natural language messages from the user
- Support existing and new conversations
- Persist all conversation data in the database
- Remain fully stateless between requests

Chat behavior:
- If conversation_id is not provided, create a new conversation
- Load full conversation history from the database for each request
- Append the new user message to the conversation
- Pass conversation history + new message to the AI agent
- Store the assistant response in the database
- Return conversation_id, response text, and tool usage metadata

Constraints:
- The server must not store in-memory chat state
- Conversation continuity must survive server restarts
- Enforce user ownership on all conversation data")
